en: Test for English Majors 2021.
zh: 2021年英语专业全国统一考试。

en: Grade 8.
zh: 专业八级。

en: Part 1 Listening Comprehension.
zh: 第一部分：听力理解。

en: Section A mini-lecture.
zh: A节：短讲。

en: In this section, you will hear a mini-lecture.
zh: 在这一节中，你将听到一段短讲。

en: You will hear the mini-lecture once only.
zh: 这段短讲只播放一遍。

en: While listening to the mini-lecture, complete the gap-filling task on answer sheet 1 and write no more than 3 words for each gap.
zh: 请边听短讲，边完成答题卡一上的填空任务；每空填写不超过三个词。

en: Make sure what you fill in is both grammatically and semantically acceptable.
zh: 请确保填入的词在语法和语义上都恰当。

en: You may use the blank sheet for note-taking.
zh: 你可以用空白纸做笔记。

en: You have 30 seconds to preview the gap-filling task.
zh: 你有三十秒钟预览填空任务。

en: Now listen to the mini-lecture.
zh: 现在请听短讲。

en: When it is over, you will be given three minutes to check your work.
zh: 短讲结束后，你将有三分钟检查作答。

en: Current Challenges Confronting U.S. Higher Education.
zh: 当前美国高等教育面临的挑战。

en: Good morning, everyone.
zh: 大家早上好。

en: In our last lecture, we discussed challenges that face universities and colleges worldwide.
zh: 上节课，我们讨论了世界各地大学和学院所面临的挑战。

en: Today we'll take a special look at U.S. higher education and see what challenges U.S. higher education is facing.
zh: 今天，我们将重点看看美国高等教育，了解它正在面临哪些挑战。

en: OK, let’s get started.
zh: 好，我们开始吧。

en: The first challenge we are examining in today’s lecture is the force of the marketplace on higher education.
zh: 今天讲座中，我们首先要考察的挑战，是市场力量对高等教育的影响。

en: Many people believe that the marketplace has overtaken state government
zh: 许多人认为，市场已经取代州政府，

en: as the dominant external force shaping and reshaping American higher education,
zh: 成为塑造和重塑美国高等教育的主导性外部力量，

en: even for public colleges and universities.
zh: 即使对于公立大学和学院也是如此。

en: You may ask, why is it so?
zh: 你可能会问，为什么会这样呢？

en: Well, as is always the case, government support is not keeping pace with educational expenditures.
zh: 事情往往就是这样：政府的支持跟不上教育开支的增长。

en: So in many ways, the market is having more bearing on higher education than government.
zh: 所以，在很多方面，市场对高等教育的影响比政府更大。

en: In order to create more flexibility, many public colleges and universities are now asking for less government regulation and supervision.
zh: 为了获得更多灵活性，许多公立大学和学院现在要求减少政府的管制和监督。

en: In some instances, they are even asking for less state money in return for more autonomy.
zh: 有时，他们甚至愿意少拿一些州政府经费，以换取更多自主权。

en: And their argument is that the current structures and accountability requirements have hindered their capacity to be effective and efficient.
zh: 他们的理由是，现有的组织结构和问责要求，妨碍了他们有效、高效地运作。

en: The ability to set their own tuition fees and secure freedom from state policies and regulations in areas such as purchasing and building
zh: 自行决定学费、在采购和建设等领域摆脱州政府政策与规章的约束，

en: represent just some of the additional autonomy that public institutions are seeking.
zh: 只是公立院校正在争取的额外自主权中的一部分。

en: And many are pressing for new legislation to provide this freedom through a range of innovations,
zh: 许多院校还在推动新的立法，通过一系列制度创新来保障这种自由，

en: including public corporations, charter colleges, state enterprise status, and performance contracts.
zh: 包括公营法人、特许学院、州属企业地位和绩效合同。

en: So what is the result of these efforts?
zh: 那么，这些努力带来了什么结果呢？

en: Well, the result is that activities and research in certain fields and disciplines, for example, engineering, applied natural science, and agricultural science,
zh: 结果是，工程、应用自然科学和农业科学等某些领域和学科的活动与研究，

en: become higher institutional priorities because they have stronger market value than other programs such as humanities do.
zh: 在院校内部被置于更优先的位置，因为它们比人文学科等专业具有更高的市场价值。

en: So what has happened is that institutions create new programs, alter academic calendars,
zh: 因此，院校开设新项目、调整校历，

en: and pursue different financial aid policies to capture more and better students — in particular those who can afford to pay high tuition.
zh: 并采取不同的助学政策，以吸引更多、更优秀的学生，尤其是那些有能力支付高额学费的学生。

en: For instance, executive MBA programs are increasingly popular.
zh: 例如，高级管理人员工商管理硕士项目越来越受欢迎。

en: Also, institutions seek contracts and partnership agreements, and enhance research programs with practical applications that have large financial payouts.
zh: 此外，院校还会争取合同和合作协议，并加强具有实际应用价值、能带来可观经济回报的研究项目。

en: In order to do so, they are changing their institutional structures.
zh: 为了做到这些，他们正在改变院校的组织结构。

en: And how do they do it?
zh: 他们具体是怎么做的呢？

en: Let me tell you.
zh: 我来告诉你。

en: Institutions would add new units that focus on generating external grants and bringing new technology to market.
zh: 院校会增设新部门，专门争取外部资助，并推动新技术进入市场。

en: They would build conference centers and create for-profit subsidiaries.
zh: 他们会建设会议中心，并设立营利性附属机构。

en: All these are done to generate more revenue for institutions.
zh: 这些做法都是为了给院校创造更多收入。

en: What are the implications of this?
zh: 这会带来什么影响呢？

en: Well, the implications are that academic research is increasingly focused on marketable knowledge, entrepreneurial priorities are taking precedence,
zh: 其影响是，学术研究越来越注重可出售、符合市场需求的知识，创业和经营方面的考量被放在优先位置，

en: services are being outsourced, and students are carrying an increasing burden to pay higher tuition fees for their education.
zh: 服务被外包，而学生则承担着越来越重的高额学费负担。

en: Then how do university administrators view this trend?
zh: 那么，大学管理者如何看待这一趋势呢？

en: That is, the marketplace is showing stronger impact on how institutions are run.
zh: 也就是说，市场对院校运作方式的影响正在增强。

en: In fact, university administrators see little option except to respond to the marketplace.
zh: 事实上，大学管理者认为，除了回应市场，他们几乎没有其他选择。

en: The reason is, if their institution does not react effectively, it will not have the necessary resources to offer high-quality and diverse academic programs.
zh: 原因在于，如果院校不能作出有效回应，就无法获得提供优质、多样化学术项目所需的资源。

en: Institutions unable to compete may face hard circumstances because government support continues to fall,
zh: 无法参与竞争的院校可能面临困境，因为政府支持持续减少，

en: students become better-informed consumers, and advances in technology also widen the number and reach of competitors.
zh: 学生作为消费者掌握的信息越来越充分，而技术进步也使竞争者数量增多、覆盖范围扩大。

en: In turn, the ability to compete — for students, resources, faculty and prestige — becomes a driving strategic force.
zh: 反过来，争夺学生、资源、师资和声望的竞争能力，就成了一股重要的战略推动力。

en: At its extreme, competition can overtake more traditional academic values.
zh: 在极端情况下，竞争可能凌驾于较传统的学术价值之上。

en: However, the downside of pursuing market goals without appropriately balancing them against the public good is...
zh: 然而，如果追求市场目标时不能恰当地兼顾公共利益，就会产生弊端：

en: is that institutions will no longer be able to fulfill their social responsibility to produce well-educated citizens
zh: 院校将无法履行培养受过良好教育的公民这一社会责任；

en: and face the threat of losing their privileged place in society as they resemble more closely other market-driven organizations.
zh: 而且，由于它们越来越像其他受市场驱动的组织，也将面临失去其在社会中优越地位的威胁。

en: Now let’s move on to the second challenge facing U.S. higher education.
zh: 接下来，我们谈美国高等教育面临的第二项挑战。

en: That is the tension between competition and equality in admissions decisions.
zh: 这就是竞争与招生公平之间的矛盾。

en: Since World War II, U.S. higher education has been engaged in a process of “massification”,
zh: 自第二次世界大战以来，美国高等教育一直在经历“大众化”的过程，

en: that is, expanding to serve students from all walks of life.
zh: 也就是不断扩大规模，为各个社会阶层的学生提供教育。

en: Motivating this effort is a widespread belief in the power of education to create social and economic mobility
zh: 推动这一努力的是一种普遍信念：教育能够促进社会和经济地位的流动；

en: and a belief in the morality and social value of making higher education accessible to everyone.
zh: 同时，让每个人都能接受高等教育，也具有道德意义和社会价值。

en: Research data bear out public perceptions: When young people from low-income backgrounds complete a bachelor’s degree,
zh: 研究数据证实了公众的看法：来自低收入家庭的年轻人取得学士学位后，

en: their income and employment characteristics after graduation are equivalent to their peers from more affluent backgrounds.
zh: 其毕业后的收入和就业情况，与来自较富裕家庭的同龄人相当。

en: So education can truly be “the great equalizer”.
zh: 所以，教育确实能够成为“促进平等的重要力量”。

en: Although there is widespread public faith in the value of higher education, the progress of massification has been slow and uneven.
zh: 尽管公众普遍相信高等教育的价值，大众化的进展却一直缓慢而且不均衡。

en: And why is it slow and uneven?
zh: 为什么这个过程既缓慢又不均衡呢？

en: Well, one, higher education did not admit significant numbers of racial and ethnic minorities until after the civil rights of the 1960s forced change.
zh: 首先，直到二十世纪六十年代的民权运动推动变革之后，高等院校才开始大量招收少数族裔学生。

en: Second, despite significant expenditures on financial aid,
zh: 其次，尽管投入了大量助学经费，

en: minority and low-income individuals are still less likely to attend college than whites or students from middle- and upper-income families.
zh: 少数族裔和低收入群体上大学的可能性，仍低于白人或中高收入家庭的学生。

en: Although access gaps have nowadays narrowed somewhat, large gaps remain between completion rates.
zh: 虽然如今入学机会方面的差距有所缩小，毕业完成率之间仍然存在很大差距。

en: Low-income students come to college less prepared, and must balance academic demands with work and family responsibilities.
zh: 低收入学生入学时往往准备不足，而且必须在学业要求与工作、家庭责任之间取得平衡。

en: Finding ways to increase the enrollment rates of low-income students and encourage their success once enrolled
zh: 如何提高低收入学生的入学率，并帮助他们在入学后顺利完成学业，

en: are two of the most important problems facing American higher education.
zh: 是美国高等教育面临的两项重要问题。

en: One of the challenges to meet these goals is that they can conflict with the other central tenets of American higher education.
zh: 实现这些目标的一项难题在于，它们可能与美国高等教育的其他核心原则产生冲突。

en: That is market competition and resistance to government control, as I said before.
zh: 如前所述，这些原则就是市场竞争，以及对政府管制的抵制。

en: For example, institutional competition for the most academically talented students
zh: 例如，院校争夺学业表现最优秀学生的竞争，

en: is likely to encourage increased use of tuition discounting for students who have no financial need,
zh: 可能促使它们更多地向没有经济需要的学生提供学费优惠，

en: and this could divert resources away from low-income students who need financial aid.
zh: 从而把资源从真正需要经济资助的低收入学生身上转移走。

en: Similarly, institutions may seek to distinguish themselves in the academic marketplace by becoming more selective in admissions decisions,
zh: 同样，院校可能为了在高等教育市场中脱颖而出，在录取时提高选择性，

en: thus reducing the number of low-income students admitted.
zh: 进而减少被录取的低收入学生人数。

en: However, a primary role of government is to mediate the potentially negative effects of competition by insisting
zh: 然而，政府的一项主要职责，是调节竞争可能带来的负面影响，具体做法是坚持要求：

en: that institutions adhere to their missions and that institutions provide need-based financial assistance to students.
zh: 院校坚守自身使命，并为学生提供以经济需要为依据的资助。

en: So a constant preoccupation of American higher education is this tension between the competitive, ambitious nature of institutions
zh: 因此，美国高等教育始终关注着这样一种矛盾：一方面，院校具有竞争性和追求发展的雄心；

en: and the interests of government in promoting important public goals,
zh: 另一方面，政府需要推动重要的公共目标，

en: primary among them broad access and widespread success for all students.
zh: 而其中首要的就是扩大入学机会，并让各类学生普遍取得成功。

en: Okay.
zh: 好。

en: For today’s lecture, we have briefly discussed some of the major challenges facing U.S. higher education,
zh: 在今天的讲座中，我们简要讨论了美国高等教育面临的一些主要挑战，

en: such as the impact of the marketplace on institutions and the tension between competition and promoting public goals.
zh: 例如市场对院校的影响，以及竞争和推动公共目标之间的矛盾。

en: Now you have three minutes to check your work.
zh: 现在你有三分钟检查作答。

en: This is the end of section A mini-lecture.
zh: A节短讲到此结束。
